title: Fact-graph planted ground-truth manifest
description: Schema for the ground-truth manifest that scripts/eval/metrics.py (EQ3/EQ9) grades a fact-graph extraction run against. A conforming manifest describes facts and edges DELIBERATELY PLANTED in a corpus (spec Sec. 15.5, Run P), so precision/recall, entity-resolution cluster purity, conflict rate, and orphan rate can be computed against a known-correct answer instead of eyeballed. Field names follow the facts/edges/claims schema in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-27-fact-graph-over-collections-design.md Sec. 3 (facts.type, fact_aliases.natural_key, edges.type). A sibling corpus-generator task emits conforming instances; this repository only defines the contract.

corpus_id.description: The collection/corpus this manifest was planted into (matches claims.corpus_id in the live schema).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the manifest was generated, ISO 8601.

document_count.description: Total documents in the planted corpus (the denominator for the EQ9 conflict-rate-per-1000-documents metric).

facts.description: Every fact (ontology node) deliberately planted in the corpus.

edges.description: Every edge (ontology relationship) deliberately planted in the corpus. Optional -- a manifest testing fact extraction alone may omit it.

natural_key.description: The canonical producer slug for this fact (fact_aliases.natural_key in the live schema), e.g. 'myers-emergency-power-systems'.

type.description: Ontology node type (facts.type in the live schema), e.g. 'engagement', 'client', 'sponsor'.

aliases.description: Additional natural-key spellings/variants planted in the corpus that a correct extraction must resolve into this SAME fact (entity-resolution challenge). Used for both precision/recall matching (any alias counts as a hit) and EQ9 cluster-purity scoring (the full set -- natural_key plus aliases -- is one expected cluster).

expected_attrs.description: Attribute key/value pairs a correct extraction should record for this fact, evaluated against the live API's per-key projected value (design spec Sec. 4). Optional -- some manifests test presence/resolution only, not attribute accuracy.

source_doc_ids.description: Corpus document ids (source_doc_id / a generator-assigned stable id) this fact was planted into -- at least one.

src_natural_key.description: natural_key of the source fact (must match a facts[].natural_key or one of its aliases).

type.description: Ontology edge type (edges.type in the live schema), e.g. 'sponsored_by', 'subsidiary_of'.

dst_natural_key.description: natural_key of the destination fact (must match a facts[].natural_key or one of its aliases).
